e-faced.l: E: At least one severe exacerbation in the previous year. 2 points. The paper defines a severe exacerbation as one the physician considered to require hospitalization.
F: FEV1 under 50 percent predicted. 2 points.
A: Age 70 years or over. 2 points.
C: Chronic colonization with Pseudomonas aeruginosa. 1 point.
E: Radiological extension involving more than 2 lobes. 1 point.
D: Dyspnea, mMRC grade 3 or 4. 1 point.
